description: Resolution of ManifestAmount.bps against a server-observed gross, for the SO's manifest binding. Sats edges are flat and come off the top; bps edges divide the remainder. resolved is each edge's amount and allowed its inclusive upper bound, which exceeds resolved by one for a bps edge so the SSP places the rounding dust. Go consumer: so/transfer/manifest_resolution_vectors_test.go. SP-3696.

testCases.name: remainder_one_sat
testCases.description: 999 at 60/40 floors to 599+399, one short of the gross

testCases.name: remainder_three_sats
testCases.description: A four-way split shorts by three; the remainder is bounded by the edge count, not by one

testCases.name: flat_fee_off_the_top
testCases.description: A 100-sat flat fee leaves 900 for the bps edges to divide

testCases.name: floors_to_zero
testCases.description: A 1-bps edge on 40 sats floors to zero and is not levied

testCases.name: sats_only_is_identity
testCases.description: With no bps edge the declared sats resolve to themselves

testCases.name: max_satoshi_gross
testCases.description: The whole bitcoin supply as gross; gross*10000 exceeds uint64, so resolution must widen

invalidCases.name: bps_sum_under_ten_thousand
invalidCases.description: Declares half the gross; without the sum check the window would admit it at small grosses
invalidCases.expectedError: manifest bps edges must sum to 10000: edges sum to 5000

invalidCases.name: bps_sum_over_ten_thousand
invalidCases.expectedError: manifest bps edges must sum to 10000: edges sum to 11000

invalidCases.name: flat_fees_exceed_gross
invalidCases.description: The flat fee is larger than the gross, so the remainder would underflow
invalidCases.expectedError: manifest sats edges leave nothing for the bps edges to divide: 1001 sats of 1000

invalidCases.name: flat_fees_consume_gross
invalidCases.description: The flat fee takes the whole gross, leaving the payee nothing
invalidCases.expectedError: manifest sats edges leave nothing for the bps edges to divide: 1000 sats of 1000

invalidCases.name: zero_gross_with_bps_edge
invalidCases.description: No executed value for the bps edges to divide
invalidCases.expectedError: manifest sats edges leave nothing for the bps edges to divide: no executed value to divide
